items.quote: And the whole congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and Aaron in the wilderness
items.claim: The congregation of Israel murmured against Moses and Aaron in the wilderness
items.actor: the whole congregation of the children of Israel

items.quote: for ye have brought us forth into this wilderness, to kill this whole assembly with hunger
items.claim: Moses and Aaron brought the assembly to the wilderness in order to kill them by starvation

items.quote: in the land of Egypt, when we sat by the flesh pots, and when we did eat bread to the full
items.claim: The Israelites sat by flesh pots and ate bread to fullness in Egypt
